lines.zh: 我扛着一箱月球咖啡，走得叮当响。
lines.en: I haul a crate of lunarade; the bottles clink as I walk.

lines.zh: 杯子在箱里撞，我用肩膀稳住。
lines.en: Mugs knock inside the crate; I steady them with a shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的摊子要挪到人多的路口去。
lines.en: I am moving my stall to the busy crossing.

lines.zh: 我走一路喊一路，嗓子比腿还累。
lines.en: I shout the whole way; my throat tires before my legs.

lines.zh: 炸弹碎片在袋里哗啦响，像小石子。
lines.en: Pop shots rattle in the bag like little pebbles.

lines.zh: Y型弹弓别在腰上，走一步晃一下。
lines.en: The slingshot at my waist sways with each step.

lines.zh: 我的眼长在脚边，专看别人的钱袋。
lines.en: My eye sits by my feet, watching other people's purses.

lines.zh: 脚步要快，咖啡凉了就卖不上价。
lines.en: I must hurry; cold lunarade fetches a poor price.

lines.zh: 金币在兜里，我走得像踩在鼓上。
lines.en: Gold coins in my pocket make me walk as on a drum.

lines.zh: 这条路我熟，闭着眼也能走到摊上。
lines.en: I know this road; I could reach my stall blind.

lines.zh: 我把最响的那箱放在最上面，招客。
lines.en: I put the loudest crate on top to draw a crowd.

lines.zh: 月亮照在瓶口上，一闪一闪的。
lines.en: Moonlight glints off the bottle mouths.

lines.zh: 走慢点，箱底的杯子快碎了。
lines.en: Slow down; the mugs at the crate's bottom are cracking.

lines.zh: 我拐过墙角，先喊一嗓子再摆摊。
lines.en: I round the corner, shout once, then set up.

lines.zh: 我把月球咖啡倒进杯子，泡沫涌到杯沿。
lines.en: I pour lunarade into a mug until foam crests the rim.

lines.zh: 金币我一枚枚咬，听声辨真假。
lines.en: I bite each gold coin and judge it by the sound.

lines.zh: 炸弹碎片堆成一小堆，我数到五十。
lines.en: I stack pop shots in a little pile and count to fifty.

lines.zh: Y型弹弓我拉了又松，练手感。
lines.en: I draw and release the slingshot to keep my aim.

lines.zh: 没客人，我就自己喝一杯，副作用随它。
lines.en: With no customers I drink a mug myself; side effects be damned.

lines.zh: 我的独眼盯着杯底，看还有没有剩。
lines.en: My single eye stares into the mug's bottom for leftovers.

lines.zh: 我把价牌擦亮，字要大，远处才看得见。
lines.en: I polish the price sign; big letters read from afar.

lines.zh: 咖啡在瓶里冒气，盖子压不住。
lines.en: The lunarade fizzes in its bottle; the cap barely holds.

lines.zh: 我试了一发弹弓，石子打飞了招牌。
lines.en: I test the slingshot and knock my own sign flying.

lines.zh: 扎尔村的午后很静，只有我的瓶子响。
lines.en: Zal village afternoons are quiet, save my bottles.

lines.zh: 我把空杯摞起来，摞得比我还高。
lines.en: I stack empty mugs until the tower outgrows me.

lines.zh: 十五颗心，喝三杯就跳得厉害。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts; three mugs and mine races.

lines.zh: 我在摊前踱步，等一个口渴的人。
lines.en: I pace before the stall, waiting for a thirsty soul.

lines.zh: 月亮不动，我的泡沫倒是消得很快。
lines.en: The moon does not move; my foam collapses fast.

lines.zh: 客人，你嘴唇干得发白，来一杯吧。
lines.en: Customer, your lips are pale and dry; take a mug.

lines.zh: 我脚下这只眼，先看见你的钱袋。
lines.en: The eye by my feet notices your purse first.

lines.zh: 你是来找炸的，还是来找喝的。
lines.en: Have you come for a bang or for a drink?

lines.zh: 你身上有火药味，跟我挺配。
lines.en: You smell of gunpowder; we suit each other.

lines.zh: 别站太近，我的咖啡会喷。
lines.en: Do not stand too close; my lunarade spits.

lines.zh: 我看你像能喝三杯的人。
lines.en: You look like a three-mug customer.

lines.zh: 你的手一直摸着刀，先喝口再说。
lines.en: Your hand keeps touching that blade; drink first.

lines.zh: 抬头看你太累，我蹲下跟你说话。
lines.en: Looking up tires me; I crouch to talk with you.

lines.zh: 月球咖啡的副作用，我可不负责。
lines.en: I take no blame for lunarade's side effects.

lines.zh: 你的靴子结实，踩我的杯子可惜了。
lines.en: Sturdy boots; a shame to waste them on my mugs.

lines.zh: 我闻到钱的味道，是金币吧。
lines.en: I smell money on you; gold coins, yes?

lines.zh: 你笑得这么客气，肯定想砍价。
lines.en: That polite smile means you plan to haggle.

lines.zh: 外乡人，月球上的水可不好找。
lines.en: Outsider, water is hard to find on this moon.

lines.zh: 我盯你半天了，就等你渴。
lines.en: I have watched you a while, just waiting for thirst.

lines.zh: 你带的水壶空了，我听见响。
lines.en: Your canteen sounds empty. I can hear it.

lines.zh: 我先看你脚下，再看你的脸。
lines.en: I look at your feet first, then your face.

lines.zh: 别打箱子，那里面全是我的本钱。
lines.en: Do not hit the crate; my whole capital is inside.

lines.zh: 这一下，我今天的赚头全没了。
lines.en: That blow wiped out today's earnings.

lines.zh: 十五颗心也疼，我又不是空瓶。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts hurt too; I am no empty bottle.

lines.zh: 血溅到杯子里，那杯只能倒掉。
lines.en: Blood in the mug means that mug is poured out.

lines.zh: 我捂着钱盒，你还真下得去手。
lines.en: I clutch the coin box, and you still strike me.

lines.zh: 疼得我直咧嘴，可我还站着。
lines.en: Pain twists my face, yet I stay on my feet.

lines.zh: 你打翻了我的架子，杯子滚了满地。
lines.en: You knocked over my rack; mugs rolled everywhere.

lines.zh: 扎尔人不禁打，可我嗓门还大。
lines.en: Zal are not tough, but my voice still carries.

lines.zh: 我退到箱子后面，先数金币少没少。
lines.en: I retreat behind the crate and check the gold first.

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了，别想再赊账。
lines.en: I will remember this; no more credit for you.

lines.zh: 一杯月球咖啡，金币一枚，不二价。
lines.en: One mug of lunarade, one gold coin, no haggling.

lines.zh: 买两杯送一颗炸弹碎片，很划算。
lines.en: Two mugs and a pop shot comes free; a fine deal.

lines.zh: 你钱袋响得这么好听，我耳朵都痒。
lines.en: Your purse jingles so sweetly my ears itch.

lines.zh: 这杯刚倒的，泡沫还在跳。
lines.en: This mug was just poured; the foam still dances.

lines.zh: Y型弹弓换你三枚金币，亏本卖。
lines.en: The slingshot for three gold coins; I am losing money.

lines.zh: 喝了这杯，你能跳得比扎尔高一倍。
lines.en: One mug and you will jump twice a Zal's height.

lines.zh: 副作用可能有点晕，但绝对值得。
lines.en: Side effects may include dizziness, but it is worth it.

lines.zh: 你那瓶水看着寡淡，换我的吧。
lines.en: That water looks flat; trade it for mine.

lines.zh: 金币不够？拿值钱的东西来也行。
lines.en: Short on gold? Something valuable will do.

lines.zh: 最后一箱了，卖完我就收摊。
lines.en: Last crate; when it sells, I close up.

lines.zh: 小心，箱子一倒，咖啡全完了。
lines.en: Careful; if the crate falls, all the lunarade is gone.

lines.zh: 你撞得我手里的杯子飞了出去。
lines.en: You knocked the mug right out of my hand.

lines.zh: 这一下，我赔了三枚金币的货。
lines.en: That bump cost me three gold coins of stock.

lines.zh: 我矮，你走路就不能低头看看。
lines.en: I am short; could you look down when you walk?

lines.zh: 瓶子在箱里滚，我听见一声脆响。
lines.en: Bottles rolled in the crate; I heard a sharp crack.

lines.zh: 别踩碎片，那玩意儿会炸。
lines.en: Mind the shards; those things pop.

lines.zh: 十五颗心经不起撞，我的膝盖都软了。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts cannot take a shove; my knees went soft.

lines.zh: 你把我的招牌撞歪了，客人会找错门。
lines.en: You skewed my sign; customers will miss the door.

lines.zh: 站稳，箱子底下还有半箱满的。
lines.en: Steady, half the crate is still full underneath.

lines.zh: 撞我可以，别撞我的弹弓。
lines.en: Bump me, but not my slingshot.

lines.zh: 我家的那位管账，我管吆喝。
lines.en: My partner keeps the books; I do the shouting.

lines.zh: 她嫌我喝太多咖啡，可她也喝。
lines.en: She says I drink too much lunarade, yet she drinks too.

lines.zh: 成亲那天，我们碰杯碰碎了三只。
lines.en: Wedding day, our toast broke three mugs.

lines.zh: 两个人守摊，一个喊，一个收钱。
lines.en: Two at the stall: one shouts, one takes the coins.

lines.zh: 她数金币比我快，我只好管搬箱子。
lines.en: She counts gold faster, so I haul the crates.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子先学会开瓶，才学会走路。
lines.en: Our child could open a bottle before walking.

lines.zh: 她把我藏起来的那箱咖啡找出来了。
lines.en: She found the crate of lunarade I had hidden.

lines.zh: 夜里收摊，我们分喝最后一杯。
lines.en: Closing at night, we share the last mug.

lines.zh: 她说我嗓门大，可摊子靠这嗓子活着。
lines.en: She says my voice is loud, but the stall lives on it.

lines.zh: 我们吵完架，还是一起数金币。
lines.en: After quarrels, we still count gold together.

lines.zh: 地上有枚金币，我的眼一下就亮了。
lines.en: A gold coin on the ground; my eye lights at once.

lines.zh: 摔碎的杯子我捡起来，碎片还能垫桌脚。
lines.en: I gather the broken mug; shards still shim the table.

lines.zh: 掉的炸弹碎片得赶紧捡，踩上就炸。
lines.en: Fallen pop shots must be retrieved; step on one and it pops.

lines.zh: 我弯腰慢，金币可不会等我。
lines.en: I bend slowly; gold coins will not wait.

lines.zh: 客人掉的瓶盖，我留着当筹码。
lines.en: Bottle caps customers drop, I keep as tokens.

lines.zh: 这枚铜币虽然小，也是钱。
lines.en: This copper coin is small, but it is still money.

lines.zh: 我捡起滚远的杯子，杯口没缺。
lines.en: I retrieve the mug that rolled off; its rim is whole.

lines.zh: 地上的弹丸我收进袋，下次还能用。
lines.en: Slingshot pellets I pocket for next time.

lines.zh: 谁把咖啡泼了一地，我心疼半天。
lines.en: Someone spilled lunarade; my heart aches for an hour.

lines.zh: 捡东西时我也盯着钱袋，毛病改不了。
lines.en: Even picking things up, I eye the purse; old habit.

lines.zh: 有人在我摊前停下，还带着火药味。
lines.en: Someone stopped at my stall, reeking of gunpowder.

lines.zh: 他不看咖啡，只看我装钱的盒子。
lines.en: He ignores the coffee and eyes my cash box.

lines.zh: 我的独眼看见一双靴子踩上了摊布。
lines.en: My single eye sees boots on my stall cloth.

lines.zh: 门口那人站得太直，像在等信号。
lines.en: That one stands too straight, as if waiting for a signal.

lines.zh: 铁器声一响，我先把金币盒盖上。
lines.en: At the sound of iron, I close the coin box.

lines.zh: 他手里握的是刀，不是杯子。
lines.en: He holds a blade, not a mug.

lines.zh: 杯子里的泡沫忽然不动了，气氛不对。
lines.en: The foam in my mug went still; the mood is wrong.

lines.zh: 这种脚步，扎尔人是不会这么走的。
lines.en: No Zal walks with steps like those.

lines.zh: 月亮照出他的影子，手里多了件东西。
lines.en: The moon shows his shadow, and something new in his hand.

lines.zh: 先别招呼，看他到底买不买。
lines.en: Hold the greeting; see whether he actually buys.

lines.zh: 我把手伸到摊下，摸到了弹弓。
lines.en: I reach under the stall and find my slingshot.

lines.zh: 我退到箱子后面，咖啡替我挡着。
lines.en: I back behind the crate; the lunarade shields me.

lines.zh: 我盯着他的膝盖，弹丸就往那儿打。
lines.en: I eye his knees; that is where the pellet goes.

lines.zh: 他每近一步，我就把杯子放下。
lines.en: Each step he takes, I set another mug down.

lines.zh: 我把金币盒踢到脚边，随时能跑。
lines.en: I nudge the coin box to my feet, ready to run.

lines.zh: 这人身上有股狠劲，不像来喝酒的。
lines.en: There is a hard edge to him; he is no drinker.

lines.zh: 我数着他离摊子还有几步。
lines.en: I count the steps between him and my stall.

lines.zh: 弹弓拉开了，我还没决定打哪。
lines.en: The slingshot is drawn; I have not chosen a target.

lines.zh: 我的眼贴地，看见他的脚跟离地了。
lines.en: My eye at ground level sees his heel lift.

lines.zh: 先喊一嗓子，看他敢不敢当街动手。
lines.en: I will shout once and see if he dares strike openly.

lines.zh: 我把杯子砸过去，咖啡还是烫的。
lines.en: I hurl a mug; the lunarade is still hot.

lines.zh: Y型弹弓一放，弹丸直奔你的脸。
lines.en: I loose the slingshot; the pellet flies at your face.

lines.zh: 一颗炸弹碎片扔在你脚边，快躲。
lines.en: A pop shot lands at your feet; better duck.

lines.zh: 我用空瓶敲你的手腕，瓶子先碎了。
lines.en: I break an empty bottle over your wrist.

lines.zh: 别小看矮个子，我正好打你的膝。
lines.en: Do not dismiss the short; your knees are my height.

lines.zh: 这一箱我掀了，咖啡泼你一身。
lines.en: I tip the crate and douse you in lunarade.

lines.zh: 我抡起钱盒，金币砸人也很疼。
lines.en: I swing the coin box; gold strikes hard too.

lines.zh: 打不过你，我也要炸你一身泡沫。
lines.en: I may lose, but you will wear my foam.

lines.zh: 弹弓没打中，我再补一颗。
lines.en: The slingshot missed; I load another.

lines.zh: 摊子可以再摆，这口气不能忍。
lines.en: The stall can be rebuilt; this insult cannot stand.

lines.zh: 我把摊子支在路口，第一箱咖啡开了。
lines.en: I set the stall at the crossing and crack the first crate.

lines.zh: 我从月球传送门滚出来，先摸钱盒。
lines.en: I roll out of the Lunalus portal, reaching for the coin box.

lines.zh: 炸响一声，我的招牌自己立起来了。
lines.en: With a bang, my sign stands itself up.

lines.zh: 扎尔村今天多了一个卖咖啡的。
lines.en: Zal village gains a lunarade seller today.

lines.zh: 我把金币盒放在脚边，眼也看得见。
lines.en: I set the coin box by my feet, within my eye's reach.

lines.zh: 瓶子在箱里响，我知道生意要来了。
lines.en: Bottles clink in the crate; trade is coming.

lines.zh: 先摆杯子，再摆弹弓，最后摆价牌。
lines.en: Mugs first, then the slingshot, then the price sign.

lines.zh: 月亮升到头顶，正好照我的摊子。
lines.en: The moon climbs overhead, lighting my stall just so.

lines.zh: 这地方人流量大，就是土太硬。
lines.en: Good foot traffic here, though the ground is hard.

lines.zh: 我清出一块地，先试喝一杯。
lines.en: I clear a patch of ground and test a mug myself.

lines.zh: 火别碰我的箱子，里面全是咖啡。
lines.en: Keep fire from my crate; it is all lunarade.

lines.zh: 摔下来时，我压碎了两只杯子。
lines.en: Falling, I crushed two mugs beneath me.

lines.zh: 我不太会游，口袋里还装着金币。
lines.en: I swim poorly, and my pockets are full of gold.

lines.zh: 这一炸，我自己的碎片都飞了。
lines.en: That blast scattered my own pop shots.

lines.zh: 箭射穿了我的招牌，字都花了。
lines.en: The arrow pierced my sign and smeared the letters.

lines.zh: 魔法打过来，我的咖啡全冒了烟。
lines.en: The magic hit and all my lunarade steamed.

lines.zh: 饿着肚子卖咖啡，真是讽刺。
lines.en: Selling lunarade on an empty stomach is a bitter joke.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，瓶子全亮了，像灯。
lines.en: Lightning struck; every bottle glowed like a lamp.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候，我还抱着钱盒。
lines.en: While falling, I still clutch the coin box.
